meshy_tasks.prompt: Voltarach, the thunder spider creature for a stylised 3D creature-collecting action RPG: the SAME character with the same body shape, same eight spiked legs, same pose and same proportions as the 3D model render (first image), repainted to match the board reference art. The whole body is a DARK carapace: deep charcoal-navy (#1c2230 to #262c3a) armour plates covering the head, the body, the abdomen and all eight legs, matte with subtle cool grey edge highlights. Across that dark armour run THIN glowing amber-gold lightning circuit lines (#e0a52a), narrow crisp branching lines only, never wide bands, never gold-filled plates; at least 85 percent of the surface is the dark charcoal-navy. The legs are dark charcoal with only a thin gold line along each segment; the leg tips stay dark, not gold. The abdomen is SMOOTH, broad dark armour plates with a few thin gold lines, not a pinecone, no rows of bumpy high-contrast scales. On the front of the head a cluster of several LARGE round glowing electric-blue eyes (#3a4dff) with a soft blue glow around them, clearly visible. Stylised hand-painted creature-game look, clean readable colour blocks, Palworld / Pokemon Legends style 3D render, not photoreal. Full body in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, no scenery, no text. Absolutely no red, pink, maroon, crimson or oxblood anywhere. Single creature only.
